journey.name: contact import after leaving
journey.description:
A contact import keeps saving after you leave the import overview, and when it finishes it leaves you where you went instead of opening Pay Contacts. Saving the prepared follows without looking them up again is covered by journeys/contacts/import-all-contacts.xml and import-selected-contacts.xml.
Precondition (not a listed capability): Pubky Ring installed on the same simulator or device and signed by the same Apple team, with an identity that follows many pubkys on pubky.app (62, as in import-all-contacts.xml), so the import takes long enough to leave. An onboarded E2E Bitkit build with Paykit UI enabled and no Pubky identity in Bitkit. The journey adopts that identity and saves its follows as contacts, so sign out of it in Bitkit before running the journey again. See README.md.
The import saves only to the device and can finish before Back is tapped; if Pay Contacts opens first, report "already imported" rather than failing.

actions.action: Tap the header profile button (id "ProfileButton"); if the profile intro (id "ProfileIntro") shows, tap Continue (id "ProfileIntro-button")
Tap the Ring row (id "PubkyChoiceRing_<pubky>") of the identity that follows many pubkys
Wait for the contact import overview (id "ContactImportOverviewProfile", predicate exists) and note the number of friends the summary (id "ContactImportOverviewSummary") shows

Tap Import All (id "ContactImportOverviewImportAll") and straight away tap Back (id "NavigationBack"). If Pay Contacts (id "PayContactsContinue") shows instead, the import finished first: report "already imported" and stop
Wait ten seconds and verify Home still shows and Pay Contacts (id "PayContactsContinue") has not opened
Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (id "DrawerContacts"); if the contacts intro shows, tap its continue button
Verify Contacts lists one row (id "Contact_<pubky>") for each of the friends the overview counted
